headline: Colorado and Arizona State battle for bowl-game relevance in Week 12
subhead: Two ranked teams fighting to salvage seasons meet in a mutual desperation game.

xFactor.why: Colorado's ability to generate pressure without blitzing could disrupt Arizona State's passing game and force ground-oriented play.

keyMatchup: Arizona State's run game efficiency against Colorado's front seven will determine field position and clock management.
body: Both programs arrive winless in their last five games, and neither can afford another setback if they harbor any postseason aspirations. Colorado's loss to Washington exposed defensive vulnerabilities—they surrendered 42 points and struggled to contain vertical passing—while Arizona State's 10-point output against UCLA suggests offensive stagnation rather than defensive collapse. The margin separating these teams is negligible, but Arizona State's recent defensive performance gives them a slight edge in a low-scoring affair.

Colorado's strength has been keeping games close through discipline and field position; they've lost several games by single digits. Arizona State, conversely, has leaned on rushing production when the passing game stalls. The team that can sustain drives in the red zone will likely prevail. This is tournament-level stakes despite the rankings—a win sends a program toward bowl eligibility, while a loss essentially ends the conversation for another year.
